name: Canted Octagon
brief: A genuinely eight-sided horizontal frame with four long orthogonal rails and four evenly clipped diagonal corners. Outer body has substantial diagonal corner lands, not a rectangle with separate octagonal hole. Architecturally coherent stepped octagonal mouldings; compact paired acanthus leaves naturally bridge each diagonal corner, quieter rails of small curled leaves. No crown, no flowers, no finials. A dignified late seventeenth-century inspired canted frame. Opening is an eight-sided horizontal rectangle with equally clipped corners, NOT an ellipse. Full opaque ornamental body at all four film corners. Overall silhouette approx 116 mm wide by 92 mm high. White internal mat constant width around octagon.

A segmental cap arcs gently across the top shoulders and has a low central shell flanked by restrained acanthus. Solid carved spandrels at top corners conceal a rectangular sheet, enough shoulder mass but no rectangular backing visible. Pilaster-like leaf-wrapped side mouldings, small coherent stepped plinth corners, a short broad apron below the straight bottom, no sharp finial. Portrait picture opening also has a very shallow curved arched top, straight sides and straight bottom. Approx94 mm wide by128 mm tall. Even white internal mat.

name: Floral Corners
brief: The quietest floral frame in a coherent Baroque collection. A straight rectangular architectural frame with softly swelling acanthus at four corners, each corner a distinct small organically integrated flower-and-leaf cluster, no copied repeated rosettes. Keep broad stretches of restrained convex cove between clusters, with a few natural curling tendrils that connect carving. Different flowers: one open peony-like fleshy bloom, one partially closed bloom, one small folded blossom, one leaf-and-bud cluster, arranged in visual balance rather than a repetitive stamped garland. No ripple, corrugation, geometric panel pattern or all-over tiled texture. Flowers sculptural and broad enough to print, with crisp veins and restrained depth. No tall crown. Rectangle aperture and even white mat. Same black miniature material, fleshy relief language and approximately6mm front depth as the reference, but deliberately quieter. Approx116mm wide by92mm high.
